name: artcraft
description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
one_liner: A purpose-built creative tool, like an 'IDE for artists,' for building visual art, design, and film assets with precise, deliberate control instead of generic drag-and-drop software.
buyer: An independent game studio or motion-design team that wants a faster, more controllable tool for building visual assets than general-purpose creative software.
business_use_cases: An indie game studio uses it to prototype crafting systems and in-game art assets faster than with general 3D/design software.
A motion-design or VFX boutique adopts it as a faster pipeline tool for client work, cutting production time.
An educator builds a course teaching procedural art and design techniques using it as the primary tool.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium asset packs, plugins, or templates built on top of the engine.
Offer cloud rendering or collaboration features as a paid tier for studios.

steal_this: Build and sell a niche asset or template pack (e.g. a specific art style or crafting-system template) for this engine's early adopter community.
